knowledge:
- key_parameters: data.file=Path to the .rds file containing the compData or phyloCompData object ;; result.extent=Character string appended to the output file name to identify the DE method results ;; Rmdfunction=The name of the *.createRmd function that generates the R Markdown code for the DE analysis (e.g., "voom.limma.createRmd", "DESeq2.createRmd") ;; output.directory=Directory where results, reports, and code will be saved ;; tree=An ape phylo object representing the phylogenetic tree for inter-species analysis ;; length.matrix=Matrix of orthologous gene lengths for inter-species length normalization ;; parameters=A list of comparison parameters (e.g., fdr.threshold, tpr.threshold, comparisons) passed to runComparison
- alternatives: The package interfaces with various external DE methods such as DESeq2, edgeR (exact test, GLM), limma (voom, trend), DSS, EBSeq, NBPSeq, NOISeq, TCC, and phylolm. Users can choose these based on whether they have standard RNA-seq data or inter-species data with phylogenetic relationships (where phylolm or length-normalized limma are preferred).
- when_to_use: Use when benchmarking or comparing the performance of multiple differential expression analysis methods on a specific RNA-seq dataset (either simulated or user-provided). Also use when performing inter-species RNA-seq differential expression analysis taking phylogenetic relationships and gene lengths into account.
- pitfalls: Always check the generated code HTMLs (using generateCodeHTMLs) to ensure no errors or warnings occurred during the DE analysis and that parameters match intentions. Ensure that the unique dataset identifier uID is truly unique for each compData object, even if simulation parameters are identical. When using the GUI (runComparisonGUI), remember to press "Return" on the keyboard after modifying text box values to confirm assignments. Ensure column names in the result.table match expected names (e.g., pvalue, adjpvalue, score) for the evaluation metrics to work correctly.

workflows.name: standard_rnaseq_comparison
workflows.intent: Format user's count matrix and sample annotations into a compData object, run multiple DE methods, and compare their performance.
workflows.stages:
1. Create a compData object using the compData constructor.
2. Validate the object using check_compData.
3. Save the object to an RDS file.
4. Run differential expression analyses using runDiffExp.
5. Compare the results using runComparison.
workflows.code:
count.matrix <- matrix(round(1000*runif(4000)), 1000, 4)
sample.annot <- data.frame(condition = c(1, 1, 2, 2))
info.parameters <- list(dataset = "mytestdata", uID = "123456")
cpd <- compData(count.matrix = count.matrix, 
                sample.annotations = sample.annot, 
                info.parameters = info.parameters)
check_compData(cpd)
saveRDS(cpd, "saveddata.rds")
runDiffExp(data.file = "B_625_625_5spc_repl1.rds", result.extent = "voom.limma", Rmdfunction = "voom.limma.createRmd", output.directory = ".", norm.method = "TMM")
runDiffExp(data.file = "B_625_625_5spc_repl1.rds", result.extent = "edgeR.exact", Rmdfunction = "edgeR.exact.createRmd", output.directory = ".", norm.method = "TMM", trend.method = "movingave", disp.type = "tagwise")
runDiffExp(data.file = "B_625_625_5spc_repl1.rds", result.extent = "ttest", Rmdfunction = "ttest.createRmd", output.directory = ".", norm.method = "TMM")
file.table <- data.frame(input.files = c("B_625_625_5spc_repl1_voom.limma.rds", "B_625_625_5spc_repl1_ttest.rds", "B_625_625_5spc_repl1_edgeR.exact.rds"), stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
parameters <- list(incl.nbr.samples = NULL, incl.replicates = NULL, incl.dataset = "B_625_625", incl.de.methods = NULL, fdr.threshold = 0.05, tpr.threshold = 0.05, typeI.threshold = 0.05, ma.threshold = 0.05, fdc.maxvar = 1500, overlap.threshold = 0.05, fracsign.threshold = 0.05, comparisons = c("auc", "fdr", "tpr", "ma", "correlation"))
runComparison(file.table = file.table, parameters = parameters, output.directory = ".")

workflows.name: phylogenetic_rnaseq_comparison
workflows.intent: Format user's count matrix, sample annotations, phylogenetic tree, and gene length matrix into a phyloCompData object, run phylogenetic/length-normalized DE methods, and compare results.
input: sample.annotations (data frame with sample annotations and species IDs)
tree (phylogenetic tree in ape phylo format)
workflows.stages:
1. Create a phyloCompData object using the phyloCompData constructor.
2. Validate the object using check_phyloCompData.
3. Run differential expression analyses using runDiffExp with phylogenetic and length-normalization methods.
workflows.code:
tree <- read.tree(text = "(((A1:0,A2:0,A3:0):1,B1:1):1,((C1:0,C2:0):1.5,(D1:0,D2:0):1.5):0.5);")
sample.annotations <- data.frame(
  condition = c(1, 1, 1, 1, 2, 2, 2, 2),                 # Condition of each sample
  id.species = c("A", "A", "A", "B", "C", "C", "D", "D") # Species of each sample
  )
count.matrix <- round(matrix(1000*runif(8000), 1000))
length.matrix <- round(matrix(1000*runif(8000), 1000))
colnames(count.matrix) <- colnames(length.matrix) <- rownames(sample.annotations) <- tree$tip.label
info.parameters <- list(dataset = "mydata", uID = "123456")
cpd <- phyloCompData(count.matrix = count.matrix,
                     sample.annotations = sample.annotations,
                     info.parameters = info.parameters,
                     tree = tree,
                     length.matrix = length.matrix)
check_phyloCompData(cpd)
runDiffExp(data.file = "alt_BM_repl1.rds", result.extent = "DESeq2", Rmdfunction = "DESeq2.createRmd", output.directory = ".", fit.type = "parametric", test = "Wald")
runDiffExp(data.file = "alt_BM_repl1.rds", result.extent = "lengthNorm.limma", Rmdfunction = "lengthNorm.limma.createRmd", output.directory = ".", norm.method = "TMM", length.normalization = "TPM", data.transformation = "log2", trend = FALSE, block.factor = "id.species")
runDiffExp(data.file = "alt_BM_repl1.rds", result.extent = "phylolm", Rmdfunction = "phylolm.createRmd", output.directory = ".", norm.method = "TMM", model = "BM", measurement_error = TRUE, extra.design.covariates = NULL, length.normalization = "TPM", data.transformation = "log2")
